facts.text: From their first semester, all students at York College take the Spartan Oath, pledging to uphold the values of the college community.

sources.title: Spartan Shoutouts - York College of Pennsylvania
sources.quote: From their first semester, all students at York College of Pennsylvania take a pledge, the Spartan Oath, in which they agree to uphold the values of our College community

facts.text: York College traces its founding to 1787, when the school was incorporated as a public school named the York County Academy.

sources.title: Don't Be a Fool—Learn Some Ycp History This April Fool's Day!
sources.quote: By 1787, the school's program had grown. It became incorporated as a public school and was named the York County Academy (YCA).

facts.text: York College general education requirements include Constellations, which are groupings of advanced-level courses around broad themes addressed through multi- and interdisciplinary perspectives.

sources.title: Generation Next General Education Requirements
sources.quote: Constellations are groupings of advanced-level courses around broad themes that are addressed using multi- and interdisciplinary perspectives.
